faq_description: Clarity in Every Step: What You Need to Know About

questions.title: How long has crēation® been in business?
questions.description: With a decade of experience, since our establishment in 2009, we’ve become a trusted leader in digital marketing. Navigating through market trends and technological advancements, we continuously refine our strategies to meet the evolving needs of our clients.

questions.title: What services does crēation® offer?
questions.description: At crēation®, we redefine growth through a data-driven approach. Our expertise begins with Digital Strategy and Data & Analytics, forming the foundation for our high-impact services in Content Marketing, SEO, Social Media, and PPC & Biddable Media. We offer the flexibility to deploy these as specialized, stand-alone solutions or as a powerful, integrated ecosystem where every channel works in synergy to drive your business forward.

questions.title: How will  crēation® get to understand my business?
questions.description: Your goals dictate our direction. Through a strategic kickoff with your team, in-depth industry research, and rigorous data analysis, we extract the core of your business. By integrating audience insights with a precise audit of your competitors' movements, we achieve a comprehensive vision that ensures a precise, effective strategy—perfectly aligned with your objectives.

questions.title: Are there any additional or hidden costs for a digital marketing project?
questions.description: Transparency is key; all costs are outlined in our proposals. Please note that biddable media spend is billed separately from our base fees. Any additional requirements are approved by you first. No surprises—just clear investments.

questions.title: Will crēation® share what is being done on my Campaigns and the reasons why?
questions.description: Absolutely. We believe in informed collaboration. You will receive transparent reporting on every action taken, backed by the strategic reasoning and data behind it. We want you to understand the `why` as much as the results.
